metadata.title: Nvidia’s Jensen Huang Reveals AI Data Center Quick-Fix. These Stocks Are Winners.<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Nvidia Has a $10 Billion Data Center Quick-Fix. The Stocks Set to Benefit.
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s opening-salvo pitch in the chip giant leader’s keynote speech at GTC Berlin is modular, quickly-deployed data centers that would dramatically reduce the time until artificial-intelligence computing can take place. There are also key stocks set to benefit too.
